relationships.subject: KT109
relationships.evidence_quote: KT109, an inhibitor of DAGLβ with no activity against DAGLa

relationships.subject: KT109
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic and intraplantar administration of KT109, an inhibitor of DAGLβ, decreased mechanical and heat hyperalgesia in HbSS mice.

relationships.subject: KT109
relationships.evidence_quote: The levels of PGE2-G and PGE2 in HbSS mice treated with KT109 were reduced to the levels measured in HbAA mice

relationships.subject: 2-AG
relationships.evidence_quote: A single intravenous injection of 2-AG produced hyperalgesia in non-hyperalgesic HbSS mice, but not in control (HbAA) mice expressing normal human HbA.

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Oxidation of 2-AG produces prostaglandin E2-glycerol (PGE2-G), a highly potent pro-nociceptive lipid.

key_findings: DAGLβ and 2-AG elevated in hyperalgesic sickle mice; KT109 DAGLβ inhibition reduced hyperalgesia and 2-AG, PGE2, PGE2-G
Exogenous 2-AG induced hyperalgesia in non-hyperalgesic HbSS but not HbAA mice
